Riccobene Family Dentistry’s office in Fort Mill, SC offers caring, compassionate and comprehensive family dentistry, with expert staff and beautiful facilities. We’ve developed a modern, welcoming and designed-for-comfort office that’s convenient to I-77 off Fort Mill Parkway, near the beautiful Catawba River.

Dentistry done well for the whole family is our mission, and we’ve been at it for more than 25 years, with tens of thousands of happy smiles to show for it. With 70 locations throughout the Carolinas, we’ve made it convenient as well, whether you live in Fort Mill and work in Charlotte or need emergency care further afield.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Fort Mill office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.

Everyone deserves access to quality dental care. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients, ensuring you receive the best dentist in Fort Mill, SC.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
A wide variety of services are available in our Fort Mill, SC location including general dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.
Cosmetic dental services available at Riccobene Family Dentistry in Fort Mill include professional teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign® treatment.

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

The right dentist is an important choice, and we’re happy to tell you that we’re the best - but we’d rather let our satisfied patients do the talking. Read about the happy smiles in our community here. The best dentist is one that makes you feel comfortable and cared for while meeting your dental needs, and we hope Riccobene can be that for you!

Dr. Chidera Amilo, a passionate dentist, earned her DMD from the University of Connecticut. She completed a General Practice Residency at Jacobi Medical Center, gaining expertise in advanced clinical procedures. Dedicated to patient education and care, Dr. Amilo strives to empower her patients with knowledge while providing gentle, compassionate treatment. She enjoys working with patients of all ages and stays current with the latest dental advancements through continuing education. Now based in North Carolina, she enjoys tennis and traveling in her free time.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What general dental services do you offer in Fort Mill?

A wide variety of services are available in our Fort Mill, SC location including general dentistry, routine hygiene, emergency dentistry, cosmetic dentistry (including whitening) and dental implants.

What cosmetic dental services are available in Fort Mill?

Cosmetic dental services available at Riccobene Family Dentistry in Fort Mill include professional teeth whitening, veneers, and Invisalign® treatment.

What types of dental insurance do you accept in Fort Mill?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

How do I choose the best dentist in Fort Mill, SC?

The right dentist is an important choice, and we’re happy to tell you that we’re the best - but we’d rather let our satisfied patients do the talking. Read about the happy smiles in our community here. The best dentist is one that makes you feel comfortable and cared for while meeting your dental needs, and we hope Riccobene can be that for you!
